next.reason: 1985: equal-size operands compared character by character from the high-order end until an unequal pair or the low-order end; equal if all pairs equal; the first unequal pair decides by collating sequence. §2023:8.8.4.2.7 GR1 restates this ('The operands are determined to be equal if all pairs of corresponding alphanumeric characters are equal'; the first unequal pair decides by the alphanumeric collating sequence), and §2023:8.8.4.2.1 GR13 ('For comparison, an alphanumeric group item shall be treated as an elementary alphanumeric data item', alphabetic as alphanumeric) keeps group and alphabetic operands under it as in 1985. Zero-length equality and national operands are new cases, and locale-based comparison applies only 'when the alphanumeric program collating sequence in effect is locale based' (§2023:8.8.4.2.7), which no 1985 program can specify. Same results.
